The National Lottery Community Fund

Grant offer letter

Dear Programme Director,

We are pleased to confirm an award of GBP 45,000 to Riverside Community Trust
for the Community Youth Skills Programme (grant reference NLCF-2024-1182).

Reporting requirements:
- Submit an annual progress update by 31 March each year.
- Submit a final end-of-grant learning report within three months of project completion.

Payment schedule: 80% on signature, 20% on receipt of satisfactory final report.

Signed,
Grants Officer
